x: (1-t)^3*base_radius + 3*(1-t)^2*t*bottom_handle_radius + 3*(1-t)*t^2*side_handle_radius + t^3*wall_top_radius - wall_thickness * (3*(1-t)^2*(foot_height - foot_height) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_height - foot_height) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_height - side_handle_height)) / sqrt((3*(1-t)^2*(bottom_handle_radius - base_radius) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_radius - bottom_handle_radius) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_radius - side_handle_radius))^2 + (3*(1-t)^2*(foot_height - foot_height) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_height - foot_height) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_height - side_handle_height))^2)
y: (1-t)^3*foot_height + 3*(1-t)^2*t*foot_height + 3*(1-t)*t^2*side_handle_height + t^3*wall_top_height + wall_thickness * (3*(1-t)^2*(bottom_handle_radius - base_radius) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_radius - bottom_handle_radius) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_radius - side_handle_radius)) / sqrt((3*(1-t)^2*(bottom_handle_radius - base_radius) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_radius - bottom_handle_radius) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_radius - side_handle_radius))^2 + (3*(1-t)^2*(foot_height - foot_height) + 6*(1-t)*t*(side_handle_height - foot_height) + 3*t^2*(wall_top_height - side_handle_height))^2)

name: capacity
expr: pi * ((side_handle_height - foot_height) * (base_radius^2 / 12 + base_radius * bottom_handle_radius / 7 + base_radius * side_handle_radius / 14 + 2 * base_radius * wall_top_radius / 105 + 3 * bottom_handle_radius^2 / 28 + 6 * bottom_handle_radius * side_handle_radius / 35 + bottom_handle_radius * wall_top_radius / 14 + 3 * side_handle_radius^2 / 28 + side_handle_radius * wall_top_radius / 7 + wall_top_radius^2 / 12) + (wall_top_height - side_handle_height) * (base_radius^2 / 84 + base_radius * bottom_handle_radius / 28 + base_radius * side_handle_radius / 35 + base_radius * wall_top_radius / 84 + 3 * bottom_handle_radius^2 / 70 + 3 * bottom_handle_radius * side_handle_radius / 28 + bottom_handle_radius * wall_top_radius / 14 + 3 * side_handle_radius^2 / 28 + side_handle_radius * wall_top_radius / 4 + wall_top_radius^2 / 3)) + pi * rim_bead_radius * (rim_bead_x^2 * (1 + sin(rim_flare)) + rim_bead_x * rim_bead_radius * ((90 deg + rim_flare) / 1 rad + sin(2 * rim_flare) / 2) + rim_bead_radius^2 * (2 / 3 + sin(rim_flare) - sin(rim_flare)^3 / 3)) - (bowl_volume - foot_volume)
label: Capacity, brimful

name: Foot ring in closed form
eq: pi * (foot_outer_radius^2 * foot_height - (recess_diameter / 2)^2 * foot_height - recess_diameter / 2 * tan(recess_dovetail) * foot_height^2 - tan(recess_dovetail)^2 * foot_height^3 / 3) - 2 * pi * (1 - pi / 4) * ((foot_outer_radius - (10 - 3 * pi) / (12 - 3 * pi) * foot_round_radius) * foot_round_radius^2 - (foot_outer_radius + (10 - 3 * pi) / (12 - 3 * pi) * foot_cove_radius) * foot_cove_radius^2)

name: Even wall by Steiner's formula
eq: wall_thickness * (2 * pi * base_radius^2 + outer_wall_area + inner_wall_area) / 2 - pi * wall_thickness^3 * (1 - sin(rim_flare)) / 3 + pi^2 * rim_bead_radius^2 * (rim_bead_x + 4 * rim_bead_radius * sin(rim_flare) / (3 * pi))

name: Capacity between its cone and its cylinder
min: pi * ((rim_bead_z + rim_bead_radius * sin(rim_flare)) - foot_height - wall_thickness) * (base_radius^2 + base_radius * (rim_bead_x - rim_bead_radius * cos(rim_flare)) + (rim_bead_x - rim_bead_radius * cos(rim_flare))^2) / 3 + pi * (rim_bead_x - rim_bead_radius * cos(rim_flare))^2 * (bowl_height - (rim_bead_z + rim_bead_radius * sin(rim_flare)))
